limitations: Controller restart requires Root partial reconciliation using retained grant/plan/journal; it does not reset its enrollment or counters.
API error identity/class is retained; transport stdout/stderr payloads are not retained by that controller.

scientific_limits: Observer reuses receipts written after the original two-arm complete raw gate; observer itself does not validate raw truth, read SQLite or restore a scientific Model.
Fixed original N300 source; not an R8/R10 or N10000 validator.
Four pilots are excluded; only the sixty-six assigned confirmation identities form the formal independent sample.
Effects including negative or undefined values are retained; observed_utc is an observation timestamp rather than an asserted completion timestamp.
Mock controls, engineering acceptance and metadata publication do not establish calibration or external validity.
source_status: bounded metadata observer; no scientific entry replacement
